# bcdec

Unmodified `bcdec.h` and license from [iOrange/bcdec](https://github.com/iOrange/bcdec),
revision `80859ed3b7afb1c527a2a99d70c61457bea72d0c`.

Header SHA-256: `134520764d96f70a27db814173616c89ad85db95fbd3328417c7a8c77e7ca189`.

The independent MCC bitmap adapter uses this decoder for BC7 textures and
for compressed multipurpose textures that require channel conversion.
Distributed under the included MIT license option. No build changes are
needed: the adapter includes this header by relative path.
